🚀 Implementing SCD Type 2 in PySpark on Databricks

One of the most important concepts in Data Engineering is preserving historical data while handling updates efficiently.

In this implementation, I used PySpark + Databricks Delta Lake to build an SCD Type 2 pipeline that:

✅ Detects changed records
✅ Expires old records
✅ Inserts new active records
✅ Maintains historical tracking
✅ Supports audit & reporting requirements

📌 Finance Example Used:
Customer account balance updates with effective start/end dates and current flags.

💡 Why SCD Type 2 Matters?
Instead of overwriting existing data, SCD2 preserves history by maintaining multiple versions of records over time.
